name: Vallorn Compatibility Patches
description:
Compatibility patches for Vallorn.

Supported mods:
• asylum-town
• cathedral-town
• third-upgrades + wake-of-gods.level8Units (Supreme Archangel)

You can safely enable any number of sub-patches at the same time.
author: Kay
